description: This file defines a sealed class 'UnavailableExceptionFallbackException' which extends the Exception class. It represents an exception used when a specific type is unavailable during deserialization, including properties for serialized data and exception type information.

classes.name: UnavailableExceptionFallbackException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating an exception with an unavailable type during deserialization, including serialization support and debugging display.

methods.name: UnavailableExceptionFallbackException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
methods.description: Constructor used during deserialization to populate the exception's properties from serialized data.

methods.name: UnavailableExceptionFallbackException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and inner exception.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Overrides the base ToString method to include the exception type if available.

methods.name: GetDebuggerDisplay()
methods.description: Returns a string suitable for debugger display, delegating to ToString().
